E2474

Form action `{action}` does not accept `{form}`

What

Form action `{action}` does not accept `{form}`

Why

The form derives its fields from `{form}` and the one server-function action boundary must receive that exact input type.

Fix

Change `{action}` to accept `{form}` as its first parameter.
